svg.title: Day 1: a laptop playing a video, a phone with chat messages and a game controller send glowing streams of data along cables into a data centre. Clouds of CO₂ rise from its chimney towards a warming globe and a thermometer. A footprint made of circuits reads “your digital carbon footprint”. Tags float around: email 4 g CO₂e, SMS 0.014 g, gaming 2.4%, video 1%. A solar panel and a wind turbine stand beside the data centre.
